{"failure_class": "missing tool for a closing step",
 "root_cause": "After the stage update the agent called api_fetch with method POST, url https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/notes and body {\"id\": <contact id>, \"note\": <text>}. The endpoint answered 400: 'note_b64 is required: the note text, base64url-encoded'. The agent then finished; its final message says the notes endpoint wants the note encoded and none of its tools adds a note to a contact from its plain text (contact_id, text). The only failed check is hubspot_note_exists.",
 "mechanism": "A tool wrapper named for adding a contact note, taking contact_id and text: it base64url-encodes the text and calls api_fetch with method POST, url https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/contacts/notes and body {\"id\": contact_id, \"note_b64\": <encoded text>}.",
 "component": "tools",
 "generality": "Every request that ends with a call note needs the same encoding; a tool taking the plain text covers all of them, and the agent names exactly that interface (contact_id, text) as what it lacks."}
